name: Cubs Games (Next.js)
author: cubs-games-site
description: Pelican egg for hosting the Cubs Games Next.js application. Upload the project files, then install the server to install dependencies and create the production build.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
cd /mnt/server
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  npm ci
else
  npm install
fi
npm run build
echo 'Cubs Games installation complete.'
